limitations: 00_intention_contract.json does not declare an explicit consumer_fields section; consumer field ids below are inferred from evaluation_unit, rows_when_resolved, and required_semantic_distinctions and bound via semantic_identity on supplying roles.

A.description: NPDES permit identifier for the facility
EPA parameter code for the measured substance
End date of the monitoring period for the reported measurement
Referent for the reported measurement row under evaluation
Referent for the selected enforceable numeric limit value applicable to the measurement
Whether a numeric compliance comparison was performed
Whether the measurement exceeds the selected applicable enforceable numeric limit
Reason limit applicability or exceedance comparison could not be established

B.description: NPDES permit identifier for the facility
Permit discharge point / outfall identifier for the requirement
EPA parameter code for the monitoring requirement
Referent for the candidate monitoring requirement under evaluation
Federal FY2025 evaluation period context for applicability
Established outcome: required, not_required, or unresolved

C.description: NPDES permit identifier for the facility
EPA parameter code for the monitoring expectation
End date of the monitoring period for the expectation
Referent for the monitoring expectation lacking an ordinary numeric result
Evidence-established state from the Purpose C taxonomy

relations.name: facility_identified
relations.meaning: A regulated facility is identified by its NPDES permit number in compiled sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to source_manifest.json facility entry or CSV EXTERNAL_PERMIT_NMBR observation.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one tuple per in-scope permit number (NM0020583, NM0028762, NM0000116) from structured extracts and manifest.

relations.name: discharge_point_identified
relations.meaning: A permit discharge point (outfall/feature) is identified for a facility in compiled limit and DMR sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to permit_limits.csv or dmr_measurements.csv PERM_FEATURE_NMBR row.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit distinct facility–feature_number pairs from structured CSV columns without merging across facilities.

relations.name: parameter_identified
relations.meaning: A monitored parameter is identified by EPA parameter code and description in compiled sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to PARAMETER_CODE and PARAMETER_DESC observation in structured CSV.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit one tuple per distinct parameter code appearing in in-scope structured extracts.

relations.name: permit_limit_value_stated
relations.meaning: A numeric or qualitative limit value is stated in compiled permit limit sources for a facility, discharge point, and parameter with documented temporal scope and limit metadata.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to permit_limits.csv row via LIMIT_VALUE_ID and source file pointer.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse permit_limits.csv; one tuple per row for in-scope facilities; preserve empty numeric fields as null roles rather than inferring values.

relations.name: reported_measurement_stated
relations.meaning: A DMR-reported measurement or no-data notation exists for a facility, discharge point, parameter, and monitoring period end date in compiled measurement sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to dmr_measurements.csv row via DMR_VALUE_ID or DMR_EVENT_ID and source file pointer.
relations.construction_rule: C1: parse dmr_measurements.csv; one tuple per measurement row for in-scope facilities; retain NODI_CODE and blank numeric fields without imputing compliance meaning.

relations.name: monitoring_requirement_stated
relations.meaning: A monitoring requirement (parameter, frequency, location, and stated schedule window) is documented in permit authority or compiled limit extracts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to permit_limits.csv LIMIT_ID/LIMIT_SET rows and, where distinct, permit PDF passages cited by path and excerpt.
relations.construction_rule: C1: derive requirement referents from compiled limit schedule rows and permit schedule tables; do not resolve FY2025 applicability here.

relations.name: permit_condition_language_stated
relations.meaning: Conditional trigger language (discharge occurrence, season, events, special studies) governing a monitoring requirement is stated in permit authority documents.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to permit PDF path and excerpt (DMR_COMMENT_TEXT, LIMIT_SET_NAME, or permit narrative) without evaluating whether the condition held during FY2025.
relations.construction_rule: C1: extract explicit conditional phrases linked to requirement referents from permit_limits.csv comments and permit PDF text spans.

relations.name: documented_no_discharge_notation
relations.meaning: A source explicitly documents a no-discharge or equivalent period for a facility, discharge point, parameter, and monitoring period.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to DMR row, permit provision, or report text that explicitly states no discharge for the period.
relations.construction_rule: C1: emit only when source text or standardized notation explicitly documents no discharge; do not infer from absent numeric values.

relations.name: limit_source_classification
relations.meaning: A stated permit limit value is classified in source material as enforceable-numeric, report-only, or non-numeric for compliance comparison purposes.
relations.grounding_contract: Each accepted classification grounded to LIMIT_TYPE_CODE, OPTIONAL_MONITORING_FLAG, numeric presence, and permit narrative where codes are ambiguous.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: judge classification from compiled limit metadata and permit text; persist only grounded ACCEPT dispositions.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per permit_limit_value_stated tuple for in-scope facilities.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether source material establishes the limit as enforceable-numeric versus report-only or non-numeric for the documented limit context.

relations.name: fy2025_in_scope_measurement
relations.meaning: A reported measurement falls within Federal FY2025 and the selected facility universe for Purpose A evaluation.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt against reported_measurement_stated with explicit FY2025 date window and facility filter basis.
relations.construction_rule: C4: SQL filter MONITORING_PERIOD_END between 2024-10-01 and 2025-09-30 inclusive for NM0020583, NM0028762, NM0000116.

relations.name: measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value
relations.meaning: A reported measurement row carries an ordinary numeric reported result suitable for Purpose A limit comparison (excluding NODI-only or blank non-numeric placeholders).
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt against reported_measurement_stated using DMR_VALUE_NMBR, VALUE_TYPE_CODE, and NODI_CODE columns.
relations.construction_rule: C4: true when standard_value or value_number is present and NODI_CODE is empty; false otherwise without inferring compliance meaning.

relations.name: candidate_limit_for_measurement
relations.meaning: A permit limit value is a mechanical join candidate for a reported measurement sharing facility, discharge point, parameter, and overlapping limit effective dates.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt listing join keys and date-overlap rule applied over fy2025_in_scope_measurement and permit_limit_value_stated filtered to limit_source_classification enforceable-numeric ACCEPT where available.
relations.construction_rule: C4: equijoin on facility, discharge_point, parameter; require monitoring period_end within limit begin/end dates; include all candidates without selecting a single applicable limit.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian-filtered join of in-scope measurements to temporally overlapping stated limits with matching locational keys.

relations.name: numeric_comparison_eligible
relations.meaning: A measurement and candidate limit share compatible units, statistical basis, and numeric values such that a defensible numeric comparison can be performed mechanically.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt documenting unit codes, standard units, statistical bases, and qualifier compatibility checks.
relations.construction_rule: C4: set eligible true only on exact unit/basis alignment rules; emit ineligibility_reason text when mismatch prevents comparison without purpose-level substitution.

relations.name: numeric_exceedance_result
relations.meaning: A mechanical numeric comparison outcome between a measurement and limit value when numeric_comparison_eligible is true, respecting limit qualifier direction.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt referencing numeric_comparison_eligible tuples and the arithmetic comparison rule for <=, >= qualifiers.
relations.construction_rule: C4: compute exceeds only where eligible; set comparison_performed true on those rows; do not emit rows where eligibility is false.

relations.name: applicable_limit_judgment
relations.meaning: For a Purpose A evaluation unit, the evidence establishes which single enforceable numeric limit applies, that no limit applies for comparison, or that applicability remains indeterminate.
relations.grounding_contract: Each ACCEPT tuple grounded to candidate_limit_for_measurement evidence, permit logic, and limit_source_classification; UNRESOLVED tuples carry enumerated reason and supporting observations.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: one judgment per fy2025_in_scope_measurement with measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value true; ACCEPT selects at most one enforceable numeric limit; REJECT when comparison not applicable; UNRESOLVED when precedence or conditions are indeterminate.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per fy2025_in_scope_measurement with ordinary numeric value; optional selected_limit_value candidates drawn from candidate_limit_for_measurement tuples classified enforceable-numeric.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Which single enforceable numeric limit applies to the measurement context among candidates, or whether applicability remains indeterminate.

relations.name: fy2025_candidate_monitoring_requirement
relations.meaning: A stated monitoring requirement could apply during Federal FY2025 at a selected facility and is included in the Purpose B evaluation universe.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt against monitoring_requirement_stated with FY2025 overlap on begin/end dates and facility filter.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include requirements whose stated schedule window overlaps FY2025 for in-scope facilities regardless of resolved applicability.

relations.name: monitoring_obligation_judgment
relations.meaning: For a Purpose B evaluation unit, evidence establishes whether monitoring was required, not required, or unresolved for FY2025 given stated conditions and documented facts.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to permit_condition_language_stated, monitoring_requirement_stated, and documented operational/discharge facts; not-required requires affirmative grounds per Purpose B policy.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: one judgment per fy2025_candidate_monitoring_requirement; ACCEPT with outcome required or not_required; UNRESOLVED when condition precedent or permit ambiguity blocks classification.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: One candidate per tuple in fy2025_candidate_monitoring_requirement.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether monitoring was actually required during FY2025 for the requirement given evaluated discharge, season, permit year, event, and study conditions.

relations.name: monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result
relations.meaning: A FY2025 monitoring expectation at a selected facility lacks an ordinary numeric reported result and therefore belongs to the Purpose C evaluation universe.
relations.grounding_contract: Derivation receipt cross-referencing fy2025_in_scope_measurement, measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value false rows, and monitoring schedule expectations.
relations.construction_rule: C4: include FY2025 rows where measurement_has_ordinary_numeric_value is false or no numeric measurement exists for an expected monitoring slot identified from requirements/schedules.

relations.name: missing_evidence_judgment
relations.meaning: For a Purpose C evaluation unit, available evidence establishes the missing-result explanation among documented no-discharge, conditional not required, other documented no-data, inadequate-evidence gap, or leaves the case unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Each ACCEPT tuple grounded to documented_no_discharge_notation, DMR NODI/missing notations, monitoring_obligation_judgment outcomes, or permit provisions; gap classification only when requirement applicability is established and no documented no-data explanation applies.
relations.construction_rule: C2/C3: one judgment per monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result; ACCEPT selects one taxonomy state; UNRESOLVED when evidence insufficient; never infer compliance or violation from absence alone.
relations.unresolved_judgment: What the available evidence establishes about a missing numeric result case among the Purpose C taxonomy states.
